action.code: const sofa = window.scene.getObjectByName('sofa'); if(sofa) { sofa.position.set(2.5, 0, -1.8); window.__3D_STATE__.sofaPositionX = 2.5; window.__3D_STATE__.sofaPositionZ = -1.8; window.__3D_STATE__.interactionMode = 'idle'; }

postconditions: Sofa positioned at X=2.5, Z=-1.8 within valid bounds
Position coordinates updated in state and HUD

action.code: const sofa = window.scene.getObjectByName('sofa'); if(sofa) { const angle = 135; sofa.rotation.y = angle * Math.PI / 180; window.__3D_STATE__.sofaRotationY = angle; window.__3D_STATE__.interactionMode = 'rotating'; setTimeout(() => { window.__3D_STATE__.interactionMode = 'idle'; }, 500); }

postconditions: Sofa rotated to 135 degrees around Y-axis

action.code: const newColor = '#4B0082'; window.__3D_STATE__.upholsteryColorHex = newColor; window.__3D_STATE__.totalColorChanges = (window.__3D_STATE__.totalColorChanges || 0) + 1; window.__3D_STATE__.interactionMode = 'colorPicking'; const sofa = window.scene.getObjectByName('sofa'); if(sofa) { sofa.traverse(child => { if(child.isMesh && child.material) { child.material.color.set(newColor); } }); } setTimeout(() => { window.__3D_STATE__.interactionMode = 'idle'; }, 500);

postconditions: Upholstery color changed to royal purple #4B0082

action.code: window.__3D_STATE__.godRayIntensity = 1.5; window.__3D_STATE__.timeOfDay = 16.5; const dirLight = window.scene.getObjectByName('sunLight'); if(dirLight) { dirLight.intensity = window.__3D_STATE__.godRayIntensity; const angle = (window.__3D_STATE__.timeOfDay / 24) * Math.PI * 2; dirLight.position.set(Math.sin(angle) * 10, 5, Math.cos(angle) * 10); }

postconditions: Time of day adjusted to 16.5 hours (late afternoon)
